items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You told me about Herman Wallman or something like that. Herman Wallman wasn't there.

ctx.x: No, he liked it with the band that he heard. So he gave them something. It was there, Stocker's was about forty or fifty cents. But when he was playing at the Dolphin's, he'd get a lot of them for nothing. Just they would mail them into. Oh, yeah. To have them play and get duplicate copies. He gave us the duplicate copies.
You told me about Herman Wallman or something like that. Herman Wallman wasn't there.
He was here in San Antonio.
